name: Serotonin synthesis and MAO/COMT monoamine degradation
rationale: All members concern serotonin biosynthesis/secretion or oxidative (MAO) and COMT catabolism of dopamine and other biogenic amines, whereas the confusables cover catecholamine biosynthesis, adrenal/sympathetic development and monoamine transporter uptake.

name: Cytokinesis and post-mitotic nuclear envelope reassembly
rationale: Members cover contractile/septin ring formation, cleavage furrow and abscission plus ESCRT-III sealing and reassembly of the nuclear membrane, distinguishing it from confusables about nuclear envelope breakdown, spindle midzone assembly or endoreduplication.

name: Fc receptor signaling in hypersensitivity and antibody cytotoxicity
rationale: Members share Fc-gamma receptor activation and inhibitory/stimulatory Fc signaling driving ADCC, hypersensitivity types I, II and IV and acute antigen-driven inflammation, unlike confusables centred on FCGR-mediated phagocytosis or mast-cell FcεRI signaling.

name: Regulation of cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and regeneration
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, growth or tissue regeneration, whereas confusables concern heart morphogenesis, chamber/septum development or stress hypertrophy.

qualifier: endothelial adhesion, neutrophil and T cell
name: Leukocyte endothelial adhesion and transendothelial extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte (neutrophil, T cell) adhesion to vascular endothelium, adhesion molecule production, diapedesis and extravasation, distinct from confusables about monocyte activation, integrin signaling or endothelial shear stress.

name: Regulation of amyloid precursor protein synthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members regulate APP biosynthesis and catabolism (with the obsolete amide-metabolism regulation terms carrying the same genes), while confusables concern downstream amyloid-beta clearance, fibril formation, tangles and glial activation.

name: Pharyngeal gland, palate and spleen development
rationale: Members are development of the palate, the pharyngeal-derived thymus, thyroid and parathyroid glands, and the spleen, unlike confusables on forebrain, limb, outflow tract or neural plate patterning.

name: ER unfolded protein response translational control and apoptosis
rationale: Members cover the ER UPR with stress-induced translational attenuation, IRE1/PERK branch regulation and ER-stress apoptosis, whereas confusables emphasise HRI/GCN2 integrated stress, mitochondrial UPR or ATF6/XBP1 chaperone induction.

name: ER glycoprotein quality control and retrotranslocation to cytosol
rationale: Members concern ER quality-control compartment, glycoprotein demannosylation, retention versus exit from the ER and ER-to-cytosol retrograde transport for ERAD, unlike confusables on ER import/SRP targeting, COPII export or misfolded-protein responses.

qualifier: odorant and pheromone, olfactory system development
name: Olfactory and pheromone chemosensation and olfactory system development
rationale: Members centre on odorant/pheromone perception, olfactory receptors, olfactory-driven behaviour and nose/olfactory nerve/GnRH neuron development (with peripheral chemosensory items), whereas confusables are taste perception or cranial gland development.

name: Cyclooxygenase prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis and signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2 arachidonate release, COX synthesis of prostaglandins/thromboxanes, prostanoid receptors and responses such as fever, distinguishing them from leukotriene/lipoxin and P450 epoxygenase/hydroxylase branches.

name: Carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members concern carnitine transport/shuttle (including SLC22A5 deficiency) and ketone body synthesis and utilisation, whereas confusables are the beta-oxidation spiral or general fatty acid transport.

name: Macrophage colony-stimulating factor signaling and macrophage proliferation
rationale: All three members concern M-CSF (CSF1) signaling and macrophage proliferation, distinguishing it from microglia-focused or IL-6-family cytokine confusables.

name: SLIT-ROBO receptor signaling to Rho-family GTPases
rationale: Members describe ROBO receptor signaling through RHOA activation, CDC42/RAC1 inactivation, ABL and AKAP5, unlike confusables on commissural axon guidance, SLIT/ROBO expression, netrin or ephrin signaling.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 cytosolic dsRNA sensing and its regulation
rationale: Members concern RIG-I-like receptor signaling, its positive and negative regulators, dsRNA responses and FADD/RIP1 NF-kB activation, while confusables extend to IRF3/type I IFN induction, TRAF pathways and DNA sensing.

qualifier: HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of immune receptors
name: Proteasome function and HIV Nef/Vpu immune receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-proteasome antigen processing plus HIV Nef/Vpu-driven degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I, unlike confusables on MHC peptide loading, cross-presentation or PD-L1 degradation.

name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and their deficiencies
rationale: Members share the lipoylated PDH, OGDH, OADH and BCKDH complexes and glycine cleavage (with lysine catabolism and MSUD variants), distinguishing them from confusables on the TCA cycle proper, PDH regulation/CoA, vitamin B6 or leucine/biotin disorders.

qualifier: trophectoderm, inner cell mass and germline at implantation
name: Implantation-stage trophectoderm, inner cell mass and germline specification
rationale: Members cover trophectoderm/ICM differentiation, trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication, germline stem cell and primordial germ cell specification, and decidualization, unlike confusables on labyrinthine placenta or germ cell migration/meiosis.

name: Ionizing radiation G2 checkpoint and p53 stabilization
rationale: Members concern G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling, CDK inhibition and Cdc25A degradation, p53 phosphorylation/degradation control and responses to gamma/X-ray radiation, unlike confusables on AKT signaling, normal G2/M transition or p53-driven apoptosis.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 transcription and RUNX3 target gene regulation
rationale: Members cover SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcriptional regulation and its downregulation together with RUNX3-controlled targets, whereas confusables emphasise TGF-beta receptor cancer mutants, TGFBR3, activin and BMP signaling.

qualifier: nucleic-acid sensing and type I/III interferon
name: Antiviral nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon response
rationale: Members span RLR, endosomal TLR3/7/8/9, cGAS/STING and AIM2 sensing, IRF3/7 activation, type I/III interferon production and ISG responses, with confusables differing only by PKR, cGAMP import or dengue items.

name: Caspase-4/5, NLRC4 and AIM2 inflammasome pyroptosis and IL-18
rationale: Members concern non-canonical CASP4/5, IPAF/NLRC4 and AIM2 inflammasomes, GBP-mediated bacterial defense, pyroptosis and IL-18, unlike confusables on NLRP1/NLRP3 and IL-1 processing or extrinsic apoptosis/necroptosis.

qualifier: ER and endosome membranes, inositol phosphate dephosphorylation
name: ER and endosomal phosphoinositide synthesis and inositol phosphate dephosphorylation
rationale: Members cover PIP synthesis at ER and early/late endosome membranes and cytosolic dephosphorylation to IP2, IP and inositol, unlike confusables on Golgi/plasma membrane PIPs, IP3/IP4 synthesis or ER lipid transfer.

name: Presynaptic clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling
rationale: Members concern clathrin coat assembly/disassembly, synaptic vesicle endocytosis, clustering and recycling and active-zone structure, unlike confusables on vesicle docking/fusion, transmitter release cycles or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

name: Tryptophan catabolism via kynurenine
rationale: All members describe tryptophan degradation through kynurenine, distinguishing them from tyrosine, threonine, histidine and glycine catabolism confusables.
